name: Checkbox

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `Checkbox` component

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Specify whether the underlying input should be checked by default

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the Checkbox should be disabled

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide text for the form group for additional help

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether the label should be hidden, or not

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Specify whether the Checkbox is in an indeterminate state

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether the Checkbox is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the Checkbox is in an invalid state

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide a label to provide a description of the Checkbox input that you are exposing to the user

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `Checkbox` component

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the Checkbox is currently invalid

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the Checkbox is in an invalid state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Checkbox rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
